output.briardr-herdr.service:
# Generated by `briardr systemd-units`. Herdr's server, which owns the terminals and agents.
[Unit]
Description=Herdr server for Briardr (briardr)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=briardr
Group=briardr
WorkingDirectory=/home/briardr
Environment="HOME=/home/briardr"
Environment="PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
Environment="LANG=C.UTF-8"
ExecStart="/usr/local/bin/herdr" "--session" "briardr-dev" "server"
ExecStop="/usr/local/bin/herdr" "--session" "briardr-dev" "server" "stop"
# Stopping Herdr ends every pane, so only restart it after a crash, never on its own.
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
output.briardr.service:
# Generated by `briardr systemd-units`. Briardr itself.
[Unit]
Description=Briardr (briardr)
After=network-online.target briardr-herdr.service
Wants=network-online.target briardr-herdr.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=briardr
Group=briardr
WorkingDirectory=/opt/briardr
Environment="HOME=/home/briardr"
Environment="PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
Environment="LANG=C.UTF-8"
Environment="BRIARDR_DATA_DIR=/home/briardr/.briardr"
ExecStart="/opt/briardr/server/target/release/briardr" "serve"
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
# Exit code 75: a listen address isn't up yet (e.g. WireGuard); the log says which, and it retries.
# Exit code 78: the configuration is wrong (the log says why). Don't retry until it's fixed.
RestartPreventExitStatus=78
NoNewPrivileges=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
